t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice given was to always keep my fingers on the keys and to answer as quickly as possible. Orange, purple, pink, and blue are the best colours to opt for in terms of mushroom reward - supposedly - however this participant did not feel confident in this and could not really identify any particular pattern recurring through the experiment. Also, use the breaks!

vb_textbox.text: Hello! So, I don't think speed is particularly important. I think it's more important that you make the correct decision. I do think gnome colour is a factor in the return of mushrooms. Brown, orange, red, blue are the gnomes that seem to be the best choice in terms of amount of mushrooms found! BORB, if you want to remember it. This pattern could vary participant to participant so it could be worth checking this yourself (i.e. keeping BRB, and testing Orange against its other colour).I tried testing things like side of the screen (left gnome or right gnome) or colour of basket, but neither of these seemed to return results as consistent as gnome colour. Note that it's likely that gnome colour is only a factor in terms of increasing probability of mushroom quantity. It is not definitive, so you will still likely get 0s and 1s sometimes.
